description: Connect all real implementations in the build orchestrator for end-to-end pipeline. Update CLI to support full build command. Create test fixture.
steps: Update vtuber_pipeline/avatar/build.py - Stage 3: use real template.glb path
Stage 5: use real fit_template() with template.glb
Update vtuber_pipeline/cli.py - add build subcommand that calls build_avatar()
Run end-to-end test: vtuber-pipeline avatar build --image tests/fixtures/test_char.png --output workspace/
acceptance_criteria: build_avatar() produces character.vrm in output directory
CLI command vtuber-pipeline avatar build works
verification: python -c "from vtuber_pipeline.avatar.validator import validate_vrm; result = validate_vrm('workspace/avatar.vrm', 'workspace/'); assert result['passed'], result; print('E2E passed!')"
findings: Fixed input_gate.py to handle CUDA unavailability gracefully. Fixed template_fitting.py to handle Scene objects. Fixed expressions.py to use pygltflib for loading skinned GLB files. Fixed vrm_builder.py to handle expression dict format and output avatar.vrm consistently. All stages now connect real implementations. VRM validation passes all checks.
